content.short: A DePIN providing Web3 services for AI computing, decentralized storage, and media streaming via edge nodes.
content.description:
AIOZ Network is a decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) that provides a comprehensive suite of Web3 services, including AI computing, storage, and media streaming. Its AIOZ AI marketplace allows developers to rent GPU/CPU power, while AIOZ Storage offers an S3-compatible decentralized solution. These services are powered by a global network of edge nodes.

The platform also features AIOZ Stream, a peer-to-peer video delivery protocol for low-cost, high-quality streaming. By utilizing a decentralized content delivery network (dCDN), AIOZ improves delivery speeds and reduces costs compared to traditional centralized cloud providers.
